description: This PHP source file defines a controller class 'Step2' for the installation process of an OpenCart-based application. It manages the display and validation of system environment checks during the installation step 2, including PHP extensions, configuration file permissions, and environment settings.

classes.name: Step2
classes.description: Controller class for handling the system environment verification step during installation.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the installation environment check page, populating data related to PHP version, extensions, and config file permissions.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates the system environment again and, if successful, redirects to the next installation step.
